observations: Three photos show multiple gas cylinders of varying sizes and colors: orange, red, and blue.
The orange cylinder in the foreground is the main subject in photo 2.
The orange cylinder has visible scratches, dents, and wear on its surface.
The red cylinder has a black mesh cage around its base and a valve with a red handle.
The blue cylinder has a label with 'FARMA' and '900' visible.
The background includes a red wall, a black trash bag, and other items like a broom and a gas stove.
The seller claims '12.5kg Foreign-Used Gas Cylinders – Strong & Reliable!' and mentions 'Recently tested and certified, no leak, the valve is new.'
No visible damage to the valve or body is apparent in the photos, but no close-up of the valve or pressure gauge is shown.
